Question Choices: What complex number is represented by the point (2, -9) on the complex plane?
Hints: The horizontal coordinate is the real part.;The vertical coordinate is the imaginary part.
Solution: The horizontal coordinate/real part is a=2; the vertical coordinate/imaginary part is b=-9. Insert them in a+bi to get 2+(-9)i.

Question Choices: On which axis do purely imaginary numbers lie in the complex plane?
Hints: Purely imaginary numbers have real part 0.;Their points have horizontal coordinate 0.
Solution: A purely imaginary number has form 0+bi with b nonzero. Its horizontal coordinate is zero, so its point (0,b) lies on the vertical imaginary axis.

Question Choices: What is the complex conjugate of 6+i?
Hints: Change the sign of the imaginary part.;The imaginary part is 1.
Solution: The conjugate keeps real part 6 and reverses imaginary coefficient 1, giving 6-(1)i. On the plane this reflects across the real axis.
